title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
description: Two migrant ranch hands, George and Lennie, chase a small dream of owning land, and the dream does not survive the week.
reasons: want a classic you can finish in one sitting
like stories about friendship under pressure
want an ending that stays with you for years
are curious about Steinbeck but not ready for 500 pages
dislikes: Almost every character other than George and Lennie is a type rather than a person
The foreshadowing is heavy enough that the ending is never in doubt
